claims.claim: You can apply for the Council Tax Disability Reduction online.
claims.note: The relevant Council Tax sources give no online application method for this reduction.

claims.claim: You can apply for the Council Tax Disability Reduction by phone.
claims.note: The relevant Council Tax sources say to ask the council but give no phone application method.

claims.claim: Applicants must prove that the disabled person lives at the property.
claims.quote: You must be able to show that a disabled person lives in the property to claim a reduction.
claims.note: The evidence requirement is stated on an England-only page, while the broader Council Tax source does not establish it across the service's full scope.
